<div class="accordion-item"><h2 class="accordion-header"><button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#work-acc-quotations">Quotable Quotations</button></h2><div id="work-acc-quotations" class="accordion-collapse collapse"><div class="accordion-body">1\.	 ईषया्ज	कलहमूलं	स यात्	क्मा	मूलं	नह	समपदाम्	। ईषया्जदोर्ाद् 	नवप्शापम्	अवाप	्जनमये्जयः	॥ \[चारचया्ज	-	१२\] īrṣyā kalahamūlaṃ syāt kṣamā mūlaṃ hi sampadām | īrṣyādoṣād vipraśāpam avāpa janamejayaḥ || Jealousy is the root of quarrel, \[while\] forgiveness is the root of wealth. Janamejaya was cursed by a brahmin for the fault of jealousy. 2.	 न	त य्जयेद्	धम्जमया्जदाम्	अनप	कलयेशदशां	श्श्रतः	। हरिचिन द्ो	नह	धमा्जथषी	सयेहये	चणडालदासताम्	॥ \[चारचया्ज	-	१३\] na tyajed dharmamaryādām api kleśadaśāṃ śritaḥ | hariścandro hi dharmārthī sehe caṇḍāladāsatām ||</div></div></div>
